entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Martial Arts Handbook
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have enough control over your transformations that you can lash out at an opponent while assuming your alternate form.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Style, Shapeshifter Twist, base attack bonus +8, change shape ability, shapechanger subtype.

Benefit(s): While you are using Shapeshifter Style, if you use your change shape or wild shape ability as a standard action, you can also make a single melee attack with one of your natural weapons at your highest base attack bonus against one foe within your reach.

Special: A character with the wild shape class feature counts as having the change shape ability and shapechanger subtype for the purpose of meeting this feat’s prerequisites.
